title: Bounded Workflow V2 review-runner repair
businessObjective: Restore reliable, auditable independent review for bounded hotel AI OS tasks without changing their implementation or introducing model fallback.
technicalObjective: Repair only the Workflow V2 review runner so each review stage receives an explicit assessment-only prompt, its stdout is required to be one review-result assessment JSON object, structured progress plus cancellation are surfaced and fail closed, bound launcher traces persist under the task's durable review evidence directory, and lifecycle verification distinguishes the reviewed source head from its later evidence-only commit.
assumptions: The hardcoded CI validator list remains authoritative.
P3-001 and every other task packet, implementation artifact, lifecycle state, and review evidence remain out of scope.
The repair is local, read-only review orchestration only; it does not deploy, contact production systems, alter provider credentials, or change task routingPolicy authority.
Cancellation is a local process-control signal that records a structured cancelled terminal state and never persists a review result.

The user approved workspace-write authority solely for the designated Terra implementation stage within this packet's existing exact path allowlist; it does not grant production, provider, deployment, fallback, or cross-task authority.

The user authorized resolving the Workflow V2 review loop; the context cap is increased only from 262144 to 458752 bytes so the complete exact GOV-057 diff, durable same-task review history, exact-head verification, and routed prerequisite traces fit below the repository-wide 524288-byte ceiling. Included paths, routes, effort, permissions, commands, and product scope are unchanged.

Clean-clone inspection proved launcher review traces under artifacts/traces were gitignored and therefore non-durable. The user-authorized Terra/high implementation is independently reviewed by the packet's Sol plan and merge-risk stages while admitting only task-bound evidence/reviews/<task>/traces/*.jsonl in the existing review-result schema and validator; no other schema, authority, or product surface is changed.

Merge-risk review proved exact-head evidence cannot be committed into the same Git object it names. V2 verification therefore binds an immutable reviewed source head to a later evidence-only commit and rejects every post-review implementation path; this remains one task branch and one PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Each review profile has an explicit assessment prompt that limits the model to reviewing the governed context and emitting exactly one JSON assessment object with the review-result assessment fields.
The launcher rejects empty, non-JSON, multi-value, or schema-invalid review stdout before any review artifact is persisted.

The runner emits newline-delimited structured progress events for launch, child output, completion, failure, and cancellation without recording prompt content, environment values, or model output in traces.
Review traces retain only the governed task path, context hashes, and a canonical review-scope hash; they never retain full task-packet contents.
Launcher review traces are task-bound, committed under evidence/reviews/<task>/traces/, and independently validated from a clean clone rather than referenced from gitignored local artifacts.
V2 verification records both the immutable reviewed source head and its evidence-only commit, proves ancestry, and rejects any non-evidence change after review without requiring a reconciliation PR.
Launcher trace validation requires exactly one successful finish with exitCode 0 after the sole review-bound event, and bounded output overflow terminates the review fail closed without persistence.

Shell and Codex-app review outputs use validated staging and atomic final-path publication; rerunning the same immutable run recovers an exact partial Codex-app publication without overwriting conflicting evidence.

Merge-risk context includes every changed path and every implementation patch inline; historical machine-generated review and verification patches use deterministic SHA-256 and byte-length bindings while current prerequisite evidence remains fully included.
SIGINT and SIGTERM request graceful child cancellation, escalate only to terminate the local child when needed, emit one cancelled terminal progress event, and fail closed without review persistence.
No model/provider fallback, routing-policy change, package/dependency change, production behavior, or P3-001 modification is introduced.
requiredChecks: stage-specific prompt and JSON-only review-output enforcement
structured progress redaction and terminal-state coverage
source-head to evidence-head clean-clone lifecycle validation
singular ordered successful terminal trace and bounded-output rejection
no-fallback and P3-001 scope regression inspection
independent V2 plan, semantic, and merge-risk review
solEscalationTriggers: Any proposal to add fallback, change routingPolicy semantics, change schemas, persist partial review output, contact a provider outside the existing Codex CLI process, or alter another task enters Sol escalation and requires a revised packet.
Any cancellation design that could terminate unrelated processes or weaken evidence integrity requires Sol security review.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the single repair PR; cancellation leaves no review artifact, and existing P3-001 review evidence remains untouched.
